name: Queue Isomorphism
description: Replaced the explicit running max recurrence (which models recognize as the 2-machine flow shop completion time) with an isomorphic single-server queue model where arrival times are prefix sums of p1 and service times are p2. This reframing shifts the domain from scheduling/flow-shops to queueing theory, requiring models to independently discover that ordering a queue with dependent arrival times is algebraically equivalent to Johnson's rule.
